lore.bio:
On her rebuilt homeworld of Nexus, Rowenna Valentina Coffey Divina chose joy, her ever-present smile offering hope amidst the rubble of a government coup. There, the remnants of a fallen Monarch Titan became a symbol of sacrifice, inspiring heroic tales of Legends that Rowenna spun for her siblings. Her sense of humor would be her family’s shield against the harshness of reality, and a secret weapon in Rowenna’s own quest to be an Apex Legend.
But when tragedy struck her oldest sister Diwa, Rowenna took her family’s fate into her own hands. She snuck into the restricted battlefields, salvaging the Titan's radioactive battery. From it, Rowenna forged a combat rig, harnessing its lethal energy to fight in local tournaments. Every victory helped support her loved ones and brought her closer to becoming a Legend, but at a grave cost:
The battery’s fallout was slowly killing her.
It didn’t matter. To achieve her dream, it was a price Rowenna was ready to pay. Her success led neutral Nexus to its first invitation to the Apex Games, forcing a heated confrontation with Diwa, who recognized the armor’s fatal origin. But Rowenna had made her choice.
Now, as Conduit, she steps onto the battlefield. Equal parts fan and gladiator, fueled by the Monarch Titan's battery and her own quest to give her family a better life.
For Rowenna, an early death is inevitable, but right now–it’s Conduit’s chance for a day in the sun.

For more information on Conduit's story, see Conduit (character).

passive.name: Savior's Speed
passive.description: Sprint faster towards allies that are out of range of your tactical, including ally Death Boxes and crafters when a banner can be retrieved, Respawn Beacons and Mobile Respawn Beacons when carrying an ally banner, and downed allies without any minimum range limit. If Savior’s Speed is active when sprinting toward a Skirmisher, gain an additional 5% movement speed.

tactical.name: Radiant Transfer
tactical.description: Send a surge of energy to a teammate and yourself, temporarily regenerating shields at 15HP/s for 6s. Note: This ability cannot target Revenant while Forged Shadows is active. The recharge delay after damage has been reduced to 1s.

ultimate.name: Energy Barricade
ultimate.description: Deploy an array of shield jamming devices which damage and slow enemies.

tactics.playstyle: An aggressive support, Conduit excels in prolonged fights. She should stay slightly behind the entry fragger to instantly recharge their shields, while using her ultimate to block flanking routes.

left.name: Battpack
left.description: +1 Shield Battery stack limit. Shield Battery count shown on deathbox.

right.name: Bigger Jam
right.description: Each Ultimate jammer's damages radius increases by 10%.

left.name: Instant Barrier
left.description: Gain a portion of Radiant Transfer's shield regen instantly, but regen duration is reduced.

right.name: Enduring Barrier
right.description: Radiant Transfer's shield regen persists through taking damage.
